run_hr_lspet_extract: run hr_lspet_extract to extract HR-LSPET dataset keypoints and save results as an npz file
review_hr_lspet_extract: review hr_lspet_extract to understand how it reads joints.mat and OpenPose JSON detections
refactor_hr_lspet_extract: refactor hr_lspet_extract to support configurable scale factors and keypoint counts
test_hr_lspet_extract: test hr_lspet_extract by running it on a sample HR-LSPET dataset directory with OpenPose outputs
summarize_hr_lspet_extract: summarize hr_lspet_extract which processes PNG images and joints annotations into a training npz file
